questions: Are you having shortness of breath, and if so when did it start relative to the chest pain?
Do you have any fever, recent cough, or are you bringing up sputum?
When you take a deep breath, does the chest pain worsen (pleuritic pain) or is it more constant with movement/pressure?
Do you have any leg swelling or pain (especially in one calf) or any history of a recent long flight/immobility or surgery?
answers: Yes, I am having shortness of breath (dyspnea). It started around the same time as the chest pain—right when the pain began, which was fast (about a 6/10 onset speed). I also have trouble breathing when I lie flat (orthopnea).
No fever. I haven’t had a recent cough and I’m not bringing up any sputum.
It feels more constant and kind of gets worse with movement or pressure. When I take a deep breath, it doesn’t feel like it sharply worsens—more like a steady chest pain.
Yes, I have leg swelling. My right ankle and right calf are swollen, and my left tibia is also swollen. I haven’t had recent long flight or surgery, and my recent travel was none.
